report.method: Fit a single eave offset on spatially interleaved 4 m cells. Require at least 18 surveyed cells, 5 in each subset, an absolute offset between 0.5 m and 4 m, and 85th percentile residual under 0.35 m on held-out cells and under 0.45 m on fitting cells. Preserve footprint, terrain and roof shape.

First returns inside the exterior perimeter, with color and flatness screening. A quarter of returns were held out of the fitted elevation. Bounds and visible surface color are approximations. No equipment identity or current condition inferred.
